sahneler.metin: Explosions ripped through the carrier Bennington off Rhode Island.
Within seconds, fire swept below decks, and one hundred three men were killed.
The ship used hydraulic catapults to launch aircraft.
An inquiry found the hazard had been known.
The Navy switched to steam catapults.

aciklama:
USS Bennington was torn by explosions off Rhode Island. The cause: vaporized lubricating oil from a hydraulic catapult igniting below decks.

#shorts #engineering #firesafety
